summary: Full Phase 4 & 5 testing: backend endpoints, auth flows, tab navigation, supplements swipe deck, admin dashboard. Fixed 2 critical routing bugs. All major flows now working.

ui_bugs.issue: Regular test user (testuser@maxxapp.com) shows 'Super Admin Panel' button. The code correctly checks profile?.role === 'admin', but testuser may have admin role in Supabase despite credentials file saying role: user. Needs verification.
APP STATS section appears empty in admin dashboard - no stats numbers rendered. Likely /api/admin/stats call needs valid JWT with admin role.
Box/package icon button in top-right of Train tab is hard to click via automation (no data-testid). Manually accessible via direct URL /supplements.

bugs_fixed.issue: After login, router.replace('/(tabs)') navigated to unmatched route. Fixed to router.replace('/(tabs)/train'). Also changed admin/index, admin/users, admin/content Stack.Screen names to just 'admin' since admin has its own _layout.tsx.
Admin layout redirect on non-admin was using '/(tabs)' (broken). Fixed to '/(tabs)/train'.
Super Admin Panel navigated to '/admin/index' (unmatched). Fixed to '/admin' which correctly resolves to admin layout with index screen.

test_results.forgot password navigation: PASS - navigates to /auth/forgot-password with correct UI
test_results.Profile tab (XP bar + quick actions): PASS - shows XP progress and actions
test_results.Supplements swipe deck: PASS - Tinder-style deck with cards, skip/add buttons
test_results.Admin login + Super Admin Panel button: PASS - visible and navigates to admin dashboard
test_results.Admin dashboard loads: PASS - shows SUPER ADMIN Control Panel

action_items: Verify testuser@maxxapp.com role in Supabase - if it's 'user', investigate why Super Admin Panel shows for them (possible profile caching bug)
Admin dashboard APP STATS section is empty - investigate /api/admin/stats response and frontend rendering
Add data-testid to Train tab header supplements button for testability
critical_code_review_comments: admin/_layout.tsx: Sub-layout Stack has duplicate screen registrations (index, users, content) that are already defined in admin/_layout.tsx's own Stack - this is correct and needed
Expo Router: When admin folder has _layout.tsx, root Stack should use name='admin' not 'admin/index' - this was the root cause of admin routing failure
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fixed 3 routing bugs: (1) login redirected to /(tabs) which was unmatched - now /(tabs)/train; (2) admin panel at /admin/index was unmatched - navigation changed to /admin; (3) admin root Stack had admin/index etc instead of just admin. All main flows passing. Supplements accessible at /supplements directly. OTP screen still has wide spacing on desktop (pre-existing from iteration_1). testuser shows Super Admin Panel - investigate role in Supabase.
rca_of_issues: Root cause: Expo Router with nested _layout.tsx (admin/ folder) creates a sub-navigator where the folder itself is the route segment. The root Stack.Screen must use name='admin' not 'admin/index'. Additionally, Expo Router web mode requires full path to a leaf screen - /(tabs) alone is just a layout wrapper with no page, causing 'Unmatched Route'.
